episodes.title: Episodes
episodes.none: No episodes yet. Start by creating the first one.
episodes.form.title: Episode title
episodes.form.ideaHint: Describe a short funny situation, in Thai (at least 10 characters)
episode.noProgress: This stage has no progress counter yet
episode.rerenderHelp: Makes a new video version from the same script, images and audio. The new version is not approved.
review.title: Review & approval
review.queueEmpty: No video has passed QA and is waiting for a decision
review.qa.aiNote: AI advice: not implemented (it never approves or blocks anything)
review.exactVersion: The exact version and hash you are deciding on
review.notesRequired: Notes are required to request changes or reject
review.notPassedQa: This version has not passed QA, so it cannot be approved
review.exportHelp: Exports only the file you approved, re-checking its hash before copying. Nothing is published.
characters.title: Characters
characters.intro: The story bible. Only you change it; the writer model is never allowed to.
characters.none: No characters yet. Add the first one above.
characters.form.slugHint: Lowercase letters and digits, starts with a letter, up to 16. Cannot be changed later.
characters.form.name: Name
characters.form.statusSinceHint: Required when the character is not alive.
characters.form.loraHelp: Plain text. Name of the trained LoRA file and the word that triggers it. The image stage uses this LoRA when it is set (the file must already be in ComfyUI's loras folder). Training and reference images are not part of this screen.
episode.canon.title: Story bible for this episode
episode.inStoryDateHint: Optional. Used to check who can appear. Leave empty for no date.
episode.summaryHint: Written by you after the episode, 1 to 2000 characters. Later episodes read it.
episode.noCharacters: No characters yet. Add them on the Characters page.
episode.threads: Open threads (one per line, at most 10 lines of 200 characters)
auth.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
auth.loginHelp: Use your passkey to sign in. There is no password.
auth.enrollHelp: Open a terminal on this machine and run {cmd} to get a one-time code (valid for 10 minutes), then enter it below.
auth.label: Passkey name
auth.unsupported: Passkeys cannot run on this page. Open it through http://localhost (not 127.0.0.1) or https.
auth.err.cancelled: Cancelled or timed out in the browser. Try again.
auth.err.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the code and passkey, then try again.
auth.err.already: A passkey already exists. Sign in with it, then add another from the Security page.
auth.err.tooMany: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
security.title: Security
security.passkeysHelp: Passkeys that can sign in. At least one must remain.
security.lastOneHint: The last passkey cannot be removed.
security.sessions: Sessions end after 12 hours idle and at most 7 days (set on the server).
auth.err.duplicate: This device already holds a passkey for this app. Use another device or security key to add one.
providers.title: Providers & budget
providers.localOnly: Cloud providers are off. Every task runs locally (LOCAL_ONLY).
providers.budgetHelp: M2, budget work is not built yet.
notif.title: Discord notifications
notif.help: Text-only messages sent outward to a Discord channel. They never carry approve, reject or spend actions. The webhook address is a secret held by the server; only its last 4 characters are shown.
notif.notConfiguredHelp: Set the webhook on the server (STUDIO_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL) and restart it. Nothing is sent until then.
notif.unimplementedHelp: Events marked Not implemented cannot be turned on: nothing raises them yet.
notif.testHelp: Posts a clearly labelled test and shows the real result.
notif.testNotConfigured: Not configured: there is no webhook, so nothing was sent.
notif.testFailed: Could not reach the studio backend to send the test.
notif.event.emergency_stop: Emergency stop turned on or off
res.title: Resource limits
res.help: How many jobs may hold a resource at once. The queue reads this on every claim, so a change applies without a restart.
res.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
res.warn: Allowing {n} GPU jobs at once can run the 8 GB graphics card out of memory and crash or reset the machine, losing running work. Only continue if you have measured that it fits.
res.confirm: I understand, set the limit to {n}
res.lowerHelp: Raising the limit lets waiting jobs start. Lowering it never stops a running job; it only holds back new ones.
res.saveFailed: Could not save the limit. Nothing was changed.
pol.title: Task policies
pol.cloudOn: Cloud enabled in server config (still refused: no budget check exists)
pol.cloudOff: Cloud off: every task runs locally
pol.changeHelp: Changing a task policy, especially to one that allows cloud, is not built: it needs the budget (issue #19). All tasks stay LOCAL_ONLY.
history.title: Artifact history
history.truncated: Only the newest 1000 versions are shown
compare.title: Compare versions
compare.readOnly: Read-only view. Approving and exporting happen only on the review screen.
compare.identical: Both versions have the same hash, so the files are identical
compare.truncated: Only the first 500 differences are shown
